text.offer: Problems? Yes, I've got a few right now. A bunch of rodents have been running around the cellar lately. I'd be in your debt if you dealt with them for me. Start with the small rats: twenty of them should do.
text.progress: Those rats won't clear themselves out of my cellar.
text.complete: Twenty fewer squeakers. Good job. But I've heard bigger things moving down there. Come and see me when you're ready for them, and bring some steel.
